name: East Bay Regional Park District Lifeguard Jobs and Lifeguard Academy
city: Alameda and Contra Costa Counties, CA (regional parks and lakes)
what_you_do: You guard swimmers at district pools and beaches. You first take a 10 day paid Lifeguard Academy that teaches the skills.
who_can_apply: You must be 16 or older when the Lifeguard Academy starts in late April. You must swim 550 yards in 10 minutes or less. The district also tests a deep dive and carrying a 150 pound person in open water.
pay_detail: Paid. The program page says a competitive wage but gives no hourly rate. The 10 day Lifeguard Academy is paid, so there is no tuition.
duration: 10 day paid academy, then a seasonal job
deadline_text: The program page gives no application dates. The Lifeguard Academy begins in late April. Check the job portal for open posts.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application on the park district job portal. Pick the lifeguard posting. You must be free for all 10 days of the academy.
notes: Lifeguard I is the entry job at age 16. Head lifeguard jobs need age 18 and a finished 12th grade. The program page does not say if a work permit is needed for 16 and 17 year olds, so ask HR. The district also lists younger water programs: Junior Lifeguard Aides (ages 13 to 15) and Jr Lifeguard Cadets (ages 14 to 17), with no details on that page. Call 1-888-327-2757.
